s.n: Biker bar bean and cheese quesadillas
s.note: Crisp tortillas with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, salsa and sour cream
s.how: Spread 4 flour tortillas with 400g refried beans, scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced pickled jalapeños, then fold in half. Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with 200g tomato salsa and 150g sour cream.

s.note: Baked pastry turnovers filled with smoky chicken, egg and olives
s.how: Boil two of the eggs until hard, then cool, peel and chop. Fry the chicken mince and onion with the cumin and paprika until browned. Stir in the chopped eggs and olives and cool the filling. Cut the pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold and crimp the edges. Brush with the remaining beaten egg. Bake at 200C until golden.

m.note: Lime and cumin marinated skirt steak in corn tortillas with dried chilli salsa
m.how: Marinate 800g skirt steak in lime, 3 garlic cloves and 1 tsp cumin for 2 hours. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with a tomato and garlic for salsa roja. Grill the steak hot, slice and serve in 16 corn tortillas with onion and coriander.

w.note: Fried churros rolled in cinnamon sugar with a hot chocolate dip
w.how: Boil 250ml water with 30g butter and a pinch of salt, beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball and cool 5 minutes, then beat in 1 egg. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream and stir in 150g dark chocolate until smooth for dipping.

d.note: Hasta la vista, baby. Tequila, lime, orange liqueur, frozen solid.
d.how: Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt. Add 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur, 40ml sugar syrup and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until smooth and slushy. Pour into the glasses and garnish each with a lime wheel. Serve immediately before it shatters into puddles.
